"AMAZON PRIME FOR YOUNG ADULTS – SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY FREE TICKET PROMOTION ("Promotion")
This Promotion makes one (1) free ticket to see Spider-Man: Brand New Day in theaters available to Amazon Prime for Young Adults through Fandango, subject to availability and the following terms and conditions:
Eligibility
Only current and valid Amazon Prime for Young Adults are eligible to participate in this Promotion. Membership must be active at the time of redemption.
How to Redeem
Eligible members can redeem their free ticket by visiting Amazon's Partner Offer landing page at https://www.amazon.com/prime/partner-offers. Click the "Claim 1 free ticket" button on the Spider-Man: Brand New Day free ticket offer card. You will be redirected to Fandango with a unique promotional code automatically applied to your booking. To avoid losing your free ticket, keep the Fandango site window open and active until you have completed your booking for your selected showing. If you navigate away from or close the Fandango site before completing your booking, you may lose your free ticket. If this occurs, you may return to Amazon's Partner Offer landing page and click "Claim 1 free ticket" again, while supplies last.
Offer Period
This Promotion is available from 6/17 at 6:00 a.m. PDT through 7/31 ("Promotion Period"), or until all available tickets have been claimed, whichever comes first. Tickets are subject to availability. Once customers are redirected to Fandango, they should book the tickets on Fandango promptly, as inventory may sell out at any time.
Ticket Details
The Promotion entitles eligible members to one (1) free ticket for a standard or early access screening of Spider-Man: Brand New Day at any participating Fandango theater in the United States, where the film is showing. Valid for both standard and early access screenings, subject to availability. Tickets are non-transferable and may not be resold.
Quantity Limits
A maximum of one (1) free ticket is available per eligible Amazon Prime Young Adult Member. This Promotion is available while supplies last.
Additional Purchases
Customers may purchase more than one (1) ticket within a single Fandango order. However, the promotional code will apply a discount to only one (1) ticket per transaction. Any additional tickets in the same order will be charged at the standard retail price.
Additional Fees
Please note that if the total cost of the free ticket — including Fandango's associated fees and charges — exceeds the promotional code's value, the customer is responsible for paying the difference.
Restrictions
The promotional code is for one-time use only. Once redeemed, the code embedded in the redirect URL cannot be used again.
The promotional code may not be combined with other Fandango promotions or offers.
Tickets purchased through this Promotion are non-refundable and non-transferable. If a promotional code is used to purchase a ticket, the value of the promotional code will be forfeited and will not be refunded under any circumstances.
Expired promotional codes cannot be exchanged, replaced, renewed, or refunded. Once the Promotion Period has ended or the film is no longer in theaters, no replacements will be issued.
Resale of tickets obtained through this Promotion is strictly prohibited.
General
Amazon's role in this Promotion is limited to the distribution of promotional codes to eligible members. For all questions related to ticket bookings, order issues, or promotional code redemption on Fandango's platform, please contact Fandango directly. Amazon reserves the right to modify or cancel this Promotion at any time. This Promotion is subject to Fandango's Terms and Conditions and Privacy Notice, available at https://www.fandango.com/policies/terms-and-policies. In the event of any inconsistency between Fandango's Terms and Conditions and these Promotion terms, these Promotion terms will apply. For customer service questions about ticket bookings or the redemption process, contact Fandango's Customer Service." Enjoy!

Christmas is just days away but don’t panic, there’s still time to shop even if you don’t want to deal with the craziness at the malls! Online shopping is much less stressful!
Target: If you buy most gifts by noon central time on December 21th, they should arrive in time for Christmas (if they won’t get there by the 25th, it should be specified on the product page). Orders over $35 ship free. Another time-saver to think about is the buy online pick up in store option. Target is offering some hot last-minute gift deals right now too…$75 off a PlayStation 5, up to 55% off the newest video games, up to 50% off headphones, up to 50% off toys, and more! Check out the deal of the day on their site too today they're offering $6.99 treat makers (CUTE reindeer waffle maker), half off sweatpants and sweatshirts, and a $15 gift card with $100 select gift card purchase.
Walmart: They say they have made shipping faster this year and can get most gifts to customers by Christmas if they order at least two days ahead (by the 23rd). I recommend buying now to make sure you have the items you want with plenty of time to shop! You can buy online and pick up in store all the way through noon on Christmas Eve!
Some of my favorite last-minute deals at Walmart include Paw Patrol toys for $5 (usually $9.97), a mini chain saw for $29.99 (usually $59.99), and a Dyson Vacuum for $199.99 (usually $399.99)!

posts.text:
If you're excited to take your kids to the Arizona State Fair but would rather spend less of your hard-earned money doing it, you'll love these deals!
Every Friday from 12-6 you can get into the fair FOR FREE when you bring 10 cans to donate to Operation Santa Claus and St. Mary's Food Bank. General admission tickets are usually $15 and this is definitely a win/win! Keep in mind:
"The following items will NOT BE ACCEPTED: Bottled water and all soda, all baby food, seasoning packets, ramen noodles and “Cup O’ Noodles,” and any items in glass containers.
This deal is active October 4th, 11th, 18th, and 25th from 12pm – 6pm."
If you have a 5-14 year-old, head over here to check out the Read and Ride program. If they read three books they'll get three free rides! You can download the form here. I heard that each ride is way over $5 this year so this can save a bunch!
If you want to redeem the rides at the same time you enjoy free admission with the canned food, check out the dates that overlap: October 4th, October 11th, October 18th, and October 25th.
Some people love the food at the fair more than anything! Check out the $3 Taste Of The Fair program...
"FAIR IS… FOR THE FOODIES! One of the most prominent aspects of any Fair experience is the food. Step into a world where indulgence meets excitement, where every bite is a new adventure. The Fair isn’t just about rides and games – it’s a journey that caters to every palate. Everything from fry bread, corn dogs, funnel cakes, and more- enjoy $3 Fair food items at every food stand on FRIDAYS from 12pm to 6pm. Foodies, rejoice at this stellar deal!
This deal is active October 4th, 11th, 18th, and 25th from 12 pm – 6 pm).
Click here for Taste of the Fair Map."
If I was going to the fair I would bring canned food and show up after school on the 4th, 11th, 18th, or 25th. If I had 5-14 year-old kids, they would read books and bring their filled-out form for free rides! I would also go for a $3 powdered sugar funnel cake!
If you bring your family of four, have two kids, and each reads three books this deal could literally save you $90+ (keep in mind that you will have to bring 40 cans of food for a good cause and that you will have to pay for parking). Check out the parking options here or consider getting dropped off!

If you have an Alanis Morissette fan in your life, head over here to buy tickets to her concert happening on June 9th at 7 PM for just $25/each (usually over $50)! She's performing with Joan Jett and Morgan Wade...should be a fantastic night!
"General Admission Lawn
G-Pass can only be redeemed on mobile app
How G-Pass Works: Within an hour of purchase, your G-Pass will be in your account. Pull up the G-Pass on your mobile app. You may redeem your G-Pass via the mobile app and use it to enter the venue directly; you won’t need to redeem at will call. You will not be able to print a paper voucher for this event. Discount reflects the merchant’s current ticket prices - price may differ on day of event.
Alanis Morissette – The Triple Moon Tour with Joan Jett & The Blackhearts and Morgan Wade
Since 1995, Alanis Morissette has been one of the most influential singer-songwriter-musicians in contemporary music. Her deeply expressive music and performances have earned vast critical praise and seven Grammy awards. Morissette’s 1995 debut, “JAGGED LITTLE PILL,” was followed by nine more eclectic and acclaimed albums. She has contributed musically to theatrical releases and has acted on the big and small screen. Outside of entertainment, she is an avid supporter of female empowerment, as well as spiritual, psychological and physical wellness. In 2001, Alaniswas awarded the Global Tolerance Award by the Friends of the United Nations for her contributions to promoting tolerance through the arts. In 2016, Alanis launched Conversation with Alanis Morissette, a monthly podcast that features conversations with a variety of revered authors, doctors, educators, and therapists, covering a wide range of psychosocial topics extending from spirituality to developmentalism to art. On December 5, 2019, “JAGGED LITTLE PILL” the musical made its Broadway debut at the Broadhurst Theatre in New York City. The show was nominated for fifteen Tony Awards and won 2 Tony Awards at the 2021 ceremony. In July of 2020, Alanis released her ninth studio album, Such Pretty Forks In The Road, to rave reviews. In August of 2021, Alanis kicked off her sold out world tour celebrating 25 years of Jagged Little Pill. The tour became the #1 female-fronted tour from 2021 and also one of the Top Worldwide Tours of 2021 selling over 500,000 tickets. Alanis also stars in Fox’s sitcom, “The Great North,” which will return for season 3 in 2022. For more information visit.
Joan Jett grew up during a time when rock ‘n’ roll was off limits to girls and women, but as a teenager, she promptly blew the door to the boys’ club right off its hinges. After forming her band the Blackhearts in 1979, with whom Jett has become a Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee, she has had eight platinum and gold albums and nine Top 40 singles, including the classics “Bad Reputation,” “I Love Rock ‘N’ Roll,” “I Hate Myself For Loving You,” and “Crimson and Clover.” With a career that has spanned music, film, television, Broadway, and humanitarianism, Joan Jett remains a potent force and inspiration to generations of fans worldwide. As a producer, she has overseen seminal albums by Bikini Kill, and the Germs’ LA punk masterpiece ‘GI.’ Jett and Kenny Laguna (her longtime producer and music partner) co-founded Blackheart Records from the trunk of Kenny’s Cadillac after rejections from no less than 23 labels. 40 years later, Blackheart is a thriving entertainment company producing music, film and television, and continues to champion emerging bands. Joan Jett and the Blackhearts continue to tour the world with headlining shows alongside fellow rock legends like The Who, Green Day, Heart, and Foo Fighters. ‘Bad Reputation,’ a documentary about Jett’s life, premiered to critical acclaim at the 2018 Sundance Film Festival. Following up on the bands 2022 release Changeup, their first-ever acoustic album, Joan Jett and the Blackhearts EP Mindsets will be a RSD First vinyl release on 11/24. Mindsets is available to stream now. For more information visit.
One of Nashville’s fastest-rising and most critically acclaimed young stars, Morgan Wade released her much-anticipated sophomore album, Psychopath, Aug. 25 via Sony Music Nashville. Possessed with a raw and unflinching voice anchored by a perfect tinge of twang; the rare ability to pen honest portraits of some of life’s most precious and painful and unpredictable moments; and an onstage vulnerability that so seamlessly breaks down the wall between fan and artist, Wade has quickly made her mark on the country music scene — and the music world at large. Her stunning 2021 debut album, Reckless, was hailed as a critical triumph; it topped Rolling Stone’s Best Country and Americana Albums of 2021, with New York Times noting Wade “sounds like she’s singing from the depths of history.” In 2022, Wade was nominated as the Emerging Act of the Year at the Americana Music Honors & Awards; in 2023, Wade was nominated for New Female Artist of the Year by the Academy of Country Music and performed at major-market festivals including Bonnaroo, Lollapalooza and Austin City Limits.
While Reckless, and particularly its momentous lead single “Wilder Days,” busted down the doors and introduced Wade to a wider listenership, Psychopath is an astounding follow-up statement: the 13-track LP was crafted with the help of some of Nashville’s most extraordinary musical talents, from A-list songwriters (Julia Michaels, Natalie Hemby, Liz Rose, Lori McKenna) to studio musicians as well as Wade’s longtime producer Sadler Vaden. Most excitingly, Psychopath finds Wade peeling back layers of her psyche like never before. “I realized the more authentic you are and the more you pour yourself into your songs, and most importantly if you’re being honest, people will connect to that,” Wade says. “I want every song to get the credit it deserves.”
Enjoy!

This confluence of luxury and fun has helped earn the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess a Five Diamond rating from AAA since 1991.
Sunset Beach: The newest and largest of six onsite pools—spans 9,000 square feet and features a white-sand shore and a splash pad.
Included perks: Guests can enjoy unlimited Internet access, access to Kids Club, credit toward spa treatments, and more without a daily resort fee as it is waived.
Restaurant spotlight: Enjoy cuts of Angus beef at chef Michael Mina’s Bourbon Steak, one of five onsite restaurants.
Tee off: On one of the TPC-level golf courses.
Fairmont guest rooms: Feature a contemporary, chic southwest design highlighted by soft, neutral desert colors providing an inviting retreat for all. Rooms feature luxurious polished stone and modern, spacious walk-in showers.
Go on a Summer Adventure: Archaeological action and family fun awaits this [Summer at the Princess](https://www.scottsdaleprincess.com/summer-at-the-princess- The Legend of the Lost Temple! Hotel guests receive complimentary access to summer themed activities and programming.
Scottsdale, Arizona: Stucco Mansions amid Rocky Desert Landscape
Scottsdale once served as ranch land where farmers grew oranges and lemons and cowboys kicked up dust in the fierce, dry heat of the Sonoran Desert. That era earned Scottsdale the nickname of “The West’s Most Western Town.” Today, it is an affluent city landscaped with lush green grass and lined with stucco mansions. For a glimpse of the city’s Old West roots, head to Old Town Scottsdale, where wooden boardwalks and hitching posts sit in front of a retro ice-cream parlor and rustic specialty shops.
Upon arriving in Scottsdale, you know you’re in the desert—cacti and tumbleweeds dot the landscape, and dry shrubs and gnarled trees cover the McDowell Mountains in the distance. To get a closer look at Southwestern flora, head to the Desert Botanical Garden. There, themed trails wind past huge cacti and other moisture-hoarding succulents, best seen in the cooler early morning or twilight hours.

posts.text:
It’s Wednesday and that means it’s time once again for my favorite deals at the grocery stores this week! These days our time at the grocery store seems even more important than ever…it’s one place we go every week and we want to get in and out as quickly as possible. Prices are good through May 5th. Grocery stores have new hours to make sure they have time to restock and clean thoroughly, be sure to check those before you leave the house.
If you’re out of work, the grocery stores are definitely hiring right now.
Be sure to print off all of the April coupons.com coupons before they’re gone, then come back and print off the May coupons. Current (as I’m typing this) coupons include: $1 off Colgate Optic White toothpaste (my FAVE or select other kinds), $.50 off Pace salsa or Picante sauce, $1 off Colgate mouthwash, $3 off one Covergirl eye product, $8 off Claritin, $5 off two boxes of Clairol hair color products, and more!

posts.title: Amazing $12 Family Meal Deals for 6 from NYPD Pizza (Less Than Their Cost) and Free Kids Meals All Day Every Day With Adult Entree Purchase!
posts.excerpt: Nikki West, the CEO of NYPD Pizza is one of the kindest human beings I know. Check out how she's helping our community (you can read her full facebook post…
posts.text:
Nikki West, the CEO of NYPD Pizza is one of the kindest human beings I know. Check out how she's helping our community (you can read her full facebook post here):
"To our Valued Guests,
We know this is a stressful and trying time for all of us. We purposefully didn’t send out an email prior out of respect for your inbox. We have a longstanding excellent record with our health department and our commitment to cleanliness and food safety has never been stronger. Yes-we have absolutely added extra measures to ensure the well being of our team members and our guests and will continue to do so. A detailed list is on our website should anyone need to review it.
Right now, our primary focus along with the health and safety of our guests and team is how to best serve our community that we are so privileged to serve. Accordingly, I wanted you to know that beginning immediately, we are offering curbside pick up along with our delivery service. We have reduced capacity in our dining rooms and will continue to monitor that unless mandated otherwise. But most importantly, we are a locally owned company run by local families. We understand that kids out of school means more meals to prepare and, in some cases, more expenses that were not expected.
From today forward, our Kids Eat Free offer is valid every day and all day. It is now valid for dine in or pick up and we ask that should any family have children that relied on school meals and find themselves needing a meal, please come see us.
Additionally, we know what our grocery aisles look like. So, starting Wednesday, March 18, we will be offering our Family Pasta and Marinara as well as Family Baked Ziti for $12.00 each. It feeds up to 6 people and we are selling them at or below what our cost is.
We hope that you will allow us the honor of feeding and serving you and your families. For over 20 years we have prided ourselves on our kitchen being yours and thank you for your continued support. We have the best guests and we know that together we will get through this time.
Nikki West, CEO and the entire NYPD Pizza family. #Foodislove"
Thank you so much Nikki!
Enjoy!

The Nutcracker
Based on a novel by 19th-century romantic fabulist E.T.A. Hoffman, The Nutcracker weaves a magical tale of holiday adventure around one of the most recognizable scores in the ballet repertoire. It begins when young Clara receives a nutcracker from her godfather, a wizardly toymaker named Drosselmeyer. Sneaking downstairs to see the toy after everyone else has gone to bed, she suddenly finds herself caught in the middle of a pitched battle between the toys and an army of mice. The “Waltz of the Snowflakes” floats weightlessly above the angelic voices, whereas the “Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy” tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. A medley of exotic national dances—including a Spanish bolero and Russian Trepak—add to the phantasmagoric celebration before the whole dream ends, as all dreams must."

posts.text:
You can make a HUGE difference in the life of a foster child! DCS usually has 5-7 businesses lined up to do toy drives for foster kids but as of now they have none. YOU can change that! From Community Coordinator Pamela Harris:
"We are looking for donations of toys to be distributed to foster children in Maricopa County. We focus on collecting toys to distribute to Kinship families. These are families that are carefully watching over children while their parents are working on services to help them become a better parent. They might not only be relatives of the family. They can be a teachers, coaches, scout leaders, etc. Many of these families already have children of their own but they want to make sure that the children are with people who know them and love them.
We will accept toys starting from infants all the way up to 17 year olds. Toys can come from individuals, groups, businesses, etc. We are so thankful for the community support!!
Anyone wishing to assist can email me at Pamela.Harris@azdcs.gov or they can call me at 602-771-7029."
My sister is a biology teacher at Tempe high school and also a kinship provider to one of her students. She truly has a heart of gold as do the other kinship families who provide care for these kids. The teens are the ones who often don't get as many gifts donated. Thank you so much for considering helping these special families!

If your kids enjoy Legos and aquariums, they might really love this deal! Head over here to get an ANNUAL PASS to the Legoland Discovery Center an Sea Life Aquarium inside Arizona Mills Mall for $35.96 with Groupon promo code SALE3 (code good through 4/20). NOTE: I would check out separately for each pass you buy. Every Groupon account can use code SALE3 up to three times.
"What You'll Get
LEGOLAND Discovery Center and SEA LIFE Aquarium One-Year Membership Pass. Includes:
12 months of unlimited admission to LEGOLAND Discovery Center and SEA LIFE Arizona
20% off in LEGOLAND cafe
10% off in LEGO store and SEA LIFE retail store
10% off birthday parties at either attraction
Access to exclusive events
Membership valid for an Adult or Child
SEA LIFE Aquarium Arizona
The scenes inside Sea Life’s tanks are like a Where’s Waldo? book come to life, except the protagonists within the underwater tableau aren’t awkwardly dressed like candy canes. Thousands of fish swirl through the waters, and you could easily spend hours picking out specific species.
Seahorses, on the other hand, swim in open view. So does other marine life—especially once you enter the ocean tunnel, which simulates the experience of walking across the ocean floor. Blacktip reef sharks roam overhead and flash their menacing teeth at the cownose stingrays, who appear to smile back.
The aquarium’s more interactive attractions explain what makes undersea life so appealing. At the touchpool, for instance, education hosts explain the lives of coastal creatures, letting visitors touch everything in the exhibit, including sea stars and hermit crabs.
Even though Sea Life spans 20 displays and thousands of sea creatures, only so many creatures can call the aquarium home. To help marine life outside its walls, Sea Life runs and participates in many different conservation campaigns and programs. Sea Life aquarium rescues seals, finds permanent homes for disabled sea turtles, and breeds seahorses to protect these endangered species from extinction.
LEGOLAND Discovery Center Arizona
LEGOLAND Discovery Center Arizona is a LEGO World full of color, creativity and fun for children aged 3-10 and their families. This indoor attraction, featuring a range of educational and interactive experiences, will inspire imaginations with 2 different rides, multiple interactive play areas, and a unique 4D Theater, LEGOLAND Discovery Center is the perfect stop for family fun.
NEW INTERACTIVE EXPERIENCE OPENING SPRING 2018 – LEGO Dino Explorer
Please note, LEGOLAND Discovery Center is specifically designed for children so all adults must be accompanied by a child.
The Fine Print

posts.text:
Saturday, September 30th is National Public Lands Day and that means FREE ADMISSION to all of the national parks for all! If you live in AZ and you've never been to the Grand Canyon, there really is no excuse! We have more national parks than any other state, and they're all worth a trip (many are close together so you can hit a few in a day). Head over here for a list of all of the fee-free days. If Saturday doesn't work for you, mark Veterans Day weekend (November 11-12th) on your calendar!
If you have a fourth grader this year, don’t forget about the Every Kid in a Park program! Head over here to request a pass for them to get up to three adults and unlimited kids (or a whole car full) into every national park through August 2018.
My daughter Kaitlyn was in 4th grade last year and we definitely took advantage of the pass. We took a family road trip to Yellowstone in July and it was amazing. We made stops at other national parks along the way too.
Please share with anyone you know with a 4th grader or 4th grade teachers!
Check out all of the options in our own beautiful state:
Arizona
Casa Grande Ruins National Monument
Glen Canyon National Recreation Area

posts.title: Have You Been to Street Cafe? Incredible Food, Incredible Prices, and Proceeds Go To Feed Hungry Kids!
posts.excerpt: I had the pleasure of trying Street Cafe in Scottsdale last week and it was such a great experience! Head over here to check them out on facebook. They offer…
posts.text:
I had the pleasure of trying Street Cafe in Scottsdale last week and it was such a great experience! Head over here to check them out on facebook. They offer huge breakfasts for $6 and lunches for $7. Think about them for catering, the prices are very reasonable. The money raised all goes to help hungry kids. They're located at 10435 N. Scottsdale Road and open Monday-Friday from 8AM-2PM. The food is delicious and the idea behind the place is even better. I loved meeting the people who run the place and even two long time Alicia's Deals readers who are Street Cafe regulars. "Bags of Hope provide the nutrition necessary to properly fuel a child’s body and brain; allowing him/her to live a healthier life, attend school more regularly, score (on average) 12% better in reading and (on average) 26% better in math… A Bag of Hope (weekend food) paves the way for a better tomorrow for kids in need." Healthy food can do so much for our children's health, minds, and souls. I want to bring my kids to help pack food backpacks. They explain their mission on thir website:
"We at Street Cafe believe: ~In real food consciously prepared, we strive to know our growers and harvesters both for our food and coffee beans ~Eating should nourish the soul, the senses, the mind and the body ~You get what you pay for, we are focused on providing food and beverage value at all times ~In creating a positive work environment; provide a place where people can feel good about what they do and earn a living wage while doing it ~In having fun (especially at work), eating well, living consciously ~In accommodating your needs; we do an amazing job with special requests ~In taking care of each other and the environment: *fresh, natural, healthy ingredients *energy efficiency *recycling and composting *biodegradable containers & utensils *supporting our community and helping those in need ~In celebrating the blessings, sharing them at all times and being the salt and light to those who grace us with their patronage
Street Café & Coffee Lounge is owned and operated by 501c3 Kitchen on the Street in an effort to provide a hand-up to people in need.
Kitchen on the Street is a nonprofit organization founded by husband and wife Vince and Lisa Scarpinato. The organization provides food assistance to low-income families with a special emphasis on households with children.
The Bags of Hope (food backpack) program serves food insecure children with weekend meals and snacks. Currently 1,500 children receive a Bag of Hope each weekend of the school year! Sadly there are another 600+ children on a waiting list, waiting for weekend food. Purchases made at Street Cafe & Coffee Lounge provide financial support to the Bags of Hope program.
Both perishable and nonperishable food donations are gladly accepted at Street Cafe!
To learn more, become a volunteer or come alongside in serving the hungry and hurting of our community please visit www.KitchenOnTheStreet.org."
Enjoy, you will love this place!

"In 1984, Space Biospheres Ventures purchased a few unassuming acres north of Tucson in the shadow the Santa Catalina Mountains. There, the company expanded its sci-fi-sounding activities—the development of space-colonization technology—and built what would evolve into Biosphere 2, recently seen on The Today Show.
Designed to re-create Earth's ecosystems, the gigantic glass enclosure (some 7.2 million cubic feet and 91 feet tall in some parts) is famous for housing biospherians in the 1990s. The researchers lived completely sealed inside for extended periods, giving scientists groundbreaking data on human survivability and interaction with particular bionetworks.
The University of Arizona had the 40-acre Biosphere 2 campus donated in 2011, maintaining it as a hub of serious research while expanding its mission to encompass interactive educational outreach. Each year, thousands pass through the on-site labs and classrooms as well as stroll the Biosphere 2 interior to view films, experience multimedia exhibits, or embark on guided tours. Tours venture into the actual ecosystems, allowing earthlings to note biodiversity, smell fresh precipitation in the rain forest, and savor the softness of savannah grassland underfoot until the resident grumpy old man yells at you to get the heck off his lawn. Before their dramatic conclusion at a million-gallon ocean tank, tours delve into the basement to explore the technosphere, where visitors can witness the deep inhales and exhales of the sphere’s respiratory system."

"A shorter and equally appropriate name for Flagstaff Extreme Adventure Course would be Endor. Spread throughout the ponderosa pines of Fort Tuthill County Park, the course’s rope swings, wobbly bridges, scrambling walls, and hanging nets resemble the Ewoks’ home planet in Star Wars: Episode VI. Visitors navigate these sylvan challenges—part of five elevated obstacle courses—while strapped into safety harnesses, which also help them dart through the forest via arboreal ziplines. Ground patrols and course guides add another layer of reassurance, as do the courses themselves, color-coded to signal their difficulty level. The black course, for example, is the hardest, while the yellow one is for children only, due to its simplicity and its free entry policy for invisible friends.
Flagstaff Extreme Adventure Course's newest attraction is the Adventure Zip Lines. There are more than 30 zip lines suspended from 15 to 80 feet high in the tall Ponderosa Pines. This course includes ladders and bridges and is an active, not ‘easy’, zip line experience. The course is self-guided, and each guest will receive training to prepare themselves for a day of adventure. In addition to the course, guests should be prepared for a 5-minute walk to the beginning of the course and walking between the courses."
We had so much fun when we did the course in 2013. I can't believe how much Trey has grown since then! It will be so much fun to go back this summer.
Enjoy!

Benefits
This machine is designed to create smooth, uniform curls without the strain and fuss of twisting a traditional curling iron.
How It Works
Hair is drawn into a ceramic curl chamber, where it’s coiled and heated up until each curl is set. Users can choose to release the hair on their own or opt for a pre-set timer that beeps when it’s time to set hair free after creating a loose wave, soft curl, or more-defined curl.
How to Use It
Start by lightly misting your hair with hairspray and making sure it’s combed through and tangle-free. Choose a one-inch section of hair and position the ends at the open mouth of the curl chamber. When you close the chamber, the machine will automatically draw your hair inside, and if you choose a timer setting, it will beep to let you know when the curl is ready.

posts.excerpt: UPDATE: I just spoke with the marketing manager at Scottsdale Quarter and I just want to reiterate that you must have at least one additional receipt from a…
posts.text:
UPDATE: I just spoke with the marketing manager at Scottsdale Quarter and I just want to reiterate that you must have at least one additional receipt from a Scottsdale Quarter store to get the deal (you can't just buy a gift card and that's it). Stop into a restaurant, buy that Mac you've been wanting, get a new swimsuit, even grab a cup of coffee and enjoy the beautiful shopping experience! I LOVE Scottsdale Quarter and shop and have lunch there all the time! The American Girl store is coming soon and they have H&M, the Apple Store, Bath and Body Works, Gap, and tons of other great places! You can use the gift card to make up the difference to $450.
This is SUPER HOT! Head over here for more information about an AMAZING promotion at Scottsdale Quarter! You can get a FREE night at the Westin Kierland (worth $149) when you spend $450 at two or more shops and/or restaurants at Scottsdale Quarter. They have all kinds of stores like Sephora, Lululemon, H&M, and tons of others. The promotion goes from June 2nd-June 15th.
Here’s what I did (I called to confirm that were eligible as part of the promotion and got the deal this afternoon):
I went to C3 and bought an iced tea (they have really delicious tea). I have lunch there all the time! I would have shopped more but I was running short on time that day!
Then I went to the Scottsdale Quarter management office with my tea receipt and bought a $450 Visa gift card. There was a $2 fee but I figured since I used my credit card, I’m getting more than that in cash back. I’ll use the gift card everywhere they accept Visa until it’s gone (I hate carrying cash and always use my card and pay it off at the end of the month, so it won’t change how I do things except for using another card until it’s gone). The tea and the gift card counted as buying things in two separate shops or restaurants, so I got the voucher for the FREE night at the Westin Kierland.
We made our reservation and are so excited! Using my Visa gift card has been working out great, I just recommend that you read the information that comes with it so you know how it works!
The Scottsdale Quarter management office is open Monday-Friday from 9-5 and is located next to Urban Outfitters.
Here are the terms and conditions of the free night:
Advance reservations are required. Offer does not include resort service charge (I called and found out the resort fee is $28.07). You don’t have to pay the room tax!
Offer is valid for one-night stay from June 2nd, 2014-August 29th, 2014. Offer is based on availability.
Black out dates: 6/14, 6/21, 6/28, 7/5, 7/12, and 8/2
Voucher must be received and stay booked and redeemed by same individual. Identification will be required at check-in.
Voucher has no cash value
Guests must cancel 48 hours prior to stay
Not valid with other offers or promotions.
Enjoy!
